outcome: Prevalence of retinal haemorrhage in term newborns
cohort: 136 term neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of Dhulikhel Hospital
finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery, larger birth weight, higher gestational age, birth asphyxia, low APGAR score, were associated with an increased risk of neonatal retinal haemorrhage.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal retinal haemorrhage.
